description: The release defects of this round, as data. scripts/evidence_index.py checks every reference: that each fix commit exists and is an ancestor of the candidate, each regression file exists and is collected, and each reproduction artifact exists, parses and failed on code without the fix. Prose in docs/REVIEW_2026_10_06.md explains; this file is what is checked.

defects.title: Checkpoint bytes could run constructors through the runtime factory; a graph-version mismatch silently discarded a checkpoint
CI's startup-refusal checks grepped for text the sanitised logs no longer print; the no-database refusal took 30.9 s against a 25 s timeout
A violated evaluation budget was not terminal across turns
Failed planning attempts lost their usage; transport failure had no planning summary
Numbers, sizes and text past the reader's, digest's or columns' limits crashed ingestion
Structured logs kept identifier-shaped tokens, entities, addresses, preformatted messages and access paths
The freshness read waited on the serving pool during an outage; shutdown ignored the configure() timeout
The evidence recorder counted results from any output line

reproductions.note: recorded with the baseline's own recorder, so its counts field shows the defect (error: 680); the summary line is pytest's

defects.title: CI's image job could not start: trivy-action@0.28.0 no longer resolves
defects.note: fixed after the executable candidate 7950e71; a workflow/deployment change with no application code

defects.title: CI's PostgreSQL container (and compose's) had 64 MB of /dev/shm; the post-load parallel VACUUM failed
defects.note: fixed after the executable candidate 7950e71; a workflow/deployment change with no application code

defects.title: A supplied sample question (growth month over month) could not be planned; the refusal named the grain by its code
With an inferred market, a segment share's numerator covered all markets and its denominator only ours (59.67% reported for 26.43%); denominator-only rows lost their label
A geography reusing a territory or region name loaded, and scope -- bound by name -- widened to both

Classification rule 1.0.0 read the generator's name suffixes and made every other brand_flag 0 product a branded competitor; on unseen data a segment share reported its upper bound (50.2%) as the share (27.2% known, 23.0% of unknown class)
A dataset whose week labels follow the supplied generator's calendar-year convention across an ISO week-53 year end loaded silently, and its first batch was rejected

Two processes of one release (replicas, or the image's uvicorn --workers 2) exported the same metric series: the resource was service.name and service.version only, so each export overwrote the other's running total

Alerting checked only on paper: in the local drill (6 of 13 scenarios passed) a single audit loss, database error or pool timeout never paged (a counter first seen at its first increment is invisible to increase()), BatchRejected never fired (it read counters of the one-shot jobs process, exported once and expired), and a collector outage left no log line

reproductions.note: the drill itself (scripts/ops_drill.py) against a real collector and Prometheus; 6 passed, 7 failed

defects.title: The deployable collector configuration wrote every span and metric to local files (to /tmp by default) although its header said only when PAC_OTEL_FILE_DIR was set; and its file exporter truncated at each start, so the drill's sentinel scan covered only exports after the collector restart, not every exported trace as stated

reproductions.note: evidence/probes/collector_restart_keeps_exports.py: the real collector, a span before a restart lost after it

defects.title: A database error was logged with error type Exception: the refused audit insert (InsufficientPrivilege) read the same as a lost connection or a constraint violation

RUNBOOK §8's restore into a new cluster (bootstrap_db.py, then pg_restore) exited with 142 errors and restored no conversation, turn, run, attempt or clarification, while the database reported ready and answered questions; a stored answer was recomputed rather than replayed

reproductions.note: scripts/restore_drill.py --new-cluster following the documented procedure; the drill itself is the regression check (r5-restore-new-cluster-fixed.json), not a pytest file

defects.title: CI's Full test suite step ran without the release gate: the tests on the coherent-market fixture database (the k-07 regressions among them) skipped on an empty fixture and the step stayed green

reproductions.note: evidence/probes/ci_full_suite_gate.py runs the step as ci.yml writes it; it is the regression check (r5-ci-full-suite-gate-fixed.json). A hosted run of the changed step is pending authorization to push

defects.title: The candidate's evidence commit added trivy reports that quote the base image's GPG_KEY (the public CPython release key); gitleaks over the history found it four times, so CI's supply-chain job would have failed on a push

reproductions.note: gitleaks over the history; the rerun at the fix is r5-head-gitleaks-fixed.json

defects.verified_by: evidence/runs/r5-head-gitleaks-fixed.json (local rerun over the whole history at bbc2242)

defects.title: The release image carried eleven setuid or setgid binaries the application never uses, among them setuid-root mount, umount, su and newgrp from util-linux, whose open HIGH advisories need privilege to matter

reproductions.note: evidence/probes/image_privileged_files.py on the image tested for 84dfc1e (263a2296). The regression check is the image smoke's and CI image job's 'no setuid or setgid file' step; 42e9090's first version of that check aborted the smoke silently (kept as r5-attempt-image-42e9090-setuid-check.json) and a9de92e corrected it

defects.verified_by: evidence/runs/r5-image-setuid-fixed.json (local, the image built from a9de92e)

defects.title: Provisioning assumed a PostgreSQL superuser: as a managed database's administrator (CREATEROLE and CREATEDB, as on RDS), bootstrap_db.py stopped at CREATE DATABASE ... OWNER pac_owner (must be able to SET ROLE "pac_owner"), so no database could be provisioned, and RUNBOOK §8's restore used pg_restore --create, which such an administrator cannot run

reproductions.note: The probe runs every provisioning and restore step as rds_master_emul (LOGIN CREATEROLE CREATEDB; not SUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS or REPLICATION) in clusters of its own on local PostgreSQL 16: an emulation of RDS's permission model for these statements, not RDS

defects.verified_by: evidence/runs/r5-rds-admin-fixed.json (4ab8fd7: all 7 steps, the runtime boundary intact and an answer after provisioning and after a restore into a new cluster; the administrator gets SET on pac_owner without INHERIT, and no serving role is a member of it). Not run against RDS

defects.title: Behind a load balancer that the server does not trust, every client has the load balancer's address, so 20 failed sign-ins by anyone refuse every user's correct password for 15 minutes (MAX_FAILURES_PER_IP); nothing in the deployment configuration set FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS

reproductions.note: The real server behind a local proxy, run twice: untrusted (FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS empty), another user's correct password is refused with 429 after 20 failures from 20 forwarded addresses; trusted, the same sign-in succeeds. The fix is configuration: infra/aws-staging trusts X-Forwarded-For from the VPC range only, and the load balancer appends the address it received

defects.verified_by: evidence/runs/r5-staging-policy-tests.json (the staging module sets FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS to the VPC range, X-Forwarded-For append, ingress to the tasks from the load balancer only). Not verified through a real load balancer

defects.title: Sign-out deleted the session cookie with delete_cookie(name, path='/'): the deletion carried no Secure and no HttpOnly, so a browser ignores it for a __Host- cookie name and a scanner reports an insecure Set-Cookie. The server revoked the token, so no session survived sign-out

reproductions.note: test_signing_out_clears_the_cookie_with_the_attributes_it_was_set_with, committed as a strict xfail and run with --runxfail: the deletion lacked secure and httponly. Found while proving cookie attributes for staging: no client in the suites, the image smoke or the browser journeys ran with Secure cookies

defects.verified_by: evidence/runs/r5-logout-cookie-fixed.json (e551650, over https://testserver with PAC_COOKIE_SECURE=true); the security suite under the release gate at 436

replay_method: evidence/probes/replay_on_baseline.sh: the candidate's tests/ run against application code at the baseline (record names the copied files by digest; JUnit sanitised). evidence/probes/startup_refusal_on_baseline.py: the baseline app judged by the baseline CI's own grep.
